Wonderful place to do oil fasting detox. Although guest relations and program management could improve.

There are 6, 8, 11 days detox program, if necessary you can stay even longer, for weeks as well. Once at registration you have been given an orientation about schedule, some pills and a 1.5 litre of water bottle, there is no more guidance afterwards. No one checks on you either. You just do your own thing and collect drinks at designated time.

There is a clinic on site that is separate from the program, although being within the retreat centre the doctor knows of the program, one can see the doctor if you feel sick or have medical concern. Consultation is covered by the program but not medication or additional services. Ultimately they are separate business. This is common throughout the centre, the cafe is separate from centre reception, the retail shop is also separate as you have to pay for respective services individually and payment fees and methods are different too.

Sometimes there are volunteers who will come to centre who speaks multiple Asian languages and English. They are knowledgeable and are great help. The Thai staff level of English comprehension varies, usually receptionist has the best English.

Program activities start as early as 5am and finishes at 530pm. House keeping everyday, but it is pretty bare inside the room. Kettle, 2 glasses, hairdryer, a safety box, a fridge, a fan and a TV (only thai channels working, no streaming app). Of course there  are beds and air con. No iron or iron board, no slippers, There are towels but no face towel, no other toiletries.

You can book to come anyday of the year (as long as there are rooms).

It is common for participants to feel sick or dizziness and often sodium tablets is prescribed at the clinic, Alternatively one can add salt (this is not supplied by centre so either go buy it yourself or bring some along).

The teacher inspects your poo (which you will poo in a bucket and carried to inspection area towards the last few days of your program, it varies depending on how many days). It is best to bring mask with you as it can get smelly.

The center offers airport transport for a fee, book in advance. One can share the ride with someone to reduce the cost.

Usually the teacher will recommend maintenance program end of your retreat, therefore best to bring suitcase with space as well as luggage allowance. Average 5-10kg of additional goods purchase for thr maintenance program.

Within walking distance from centre there are two convenient store that sells from food to toiletries. It is also possible to walk to nearby beach to see sunrise (as it faces East).

There are various massage and treatment just like any resort centre, mostly for detox purposes. Tokens treatment is a Northern Thailand hammering treatment, the therapist on duty the day I received it was in a bad mood that rough handled me, argued with me about the room temperature when I politely requested to lower the aircon speed, and listened and watched YouTube video throughout the session, with his phone next to my head. He moved the phone when I turned to signal him about the noise disturbing me. One would expect this kind of behavior at many massage places outside, cheaper places unfortunately but I didnt expect it inside a resort.

Overall it was good, I suggest check out different massage options in the area as well, and ask other long term frequent visiting guests for guidance, they might give better or faster advise than the Thai staff.

TANYASAMUI Holistic Health Retreat offers a pristine environment and impeccable cleanliness, making it an ideal haven for those seeking a holistic health experience. The rooms are not only aesthetically pleasing but also maintained with a keen focus on hygiene, ensuring a comfortable stay.

The standout feature lies in the exceptional services provided by the staff. Their commitment to delivering the best experience is evident in their attention to detail and personalized care. From the moment you arrive, you'll find the staff dedicated to making your stay seamless and enjoyable.

The retreat is particularly well-suited for detox and cleansing programs, with specialized offerings to rejuvenate the body and mind. Whether you're a seasoned wellness enthusiast or a first time detox participant, TANYASAMUI provides a comprehensive approach to holistic health, guided by experienced professionals.

The inclusion of both indoor and outdoor pools adds to the allure of this retreat. The outdoor pool provides a serene setting, allowing guests to connect with nature while engaging in their wellness journey. Meanwhile, the indoor pool offers a more private and controlled environment, ensuring year-round access to aquatic therapy.

Accommodations extend beyond mere villas; TANYASAMUI features a full fledged hotel with spacious rooms designed for comfort. The expansive lobby exudes a welcoming ambiance, setting the tone for the retreat's commitment to providing a tranquil and uplifting atmosphere for guests.

In the heart of the retreat, The retreat is not just a place to stay; it's a holistic experience designed to promote well being.

TANYASAMUI Holistic Health Retreat impresses with its clean and comfortable accommodations, a staff dedicated to service excellence, specialized detox programs, inviting pools, hotel facilities, and a thoughtfully designed lobby. It's a destination where every element converges to create a holistic haven for those seeking a transformative wellness experience.

We were on a program of internal body cleansing (or we often refer it to detox) at Tanya Samui. Located on the Ko Samui, Thailand, Tanya Samui proclaims itself as a holistic health retreat center. Many foreigners who had come and gain health advantage from the program would happily share their experience by word-of-mouth and their own social media. Therefore, more and people were interested to also have the advantage, including my wife and me. For the accomodation, we chose the new building which rooms are spacious for 2 person occupancy and are equipped with smart TV, balcony and private bathroom. The rooms were cleaned every day.

Initiated and directly managed by Mrs. Tunyarat Petchprom (or also known as “Teacher” Khun Kob), the program requires us to not consume any solid food troughout our retreat, while we are free to do any other positive activity e.g.: meditating, doing yoga, socializing with other guests at the common area, exercising in the inhouse gym, swimming, hiking, going to beach, or even exploring the island. The only restriction is not to consume any other food or beverages other than provided by the program schedule. For our consumption, there is a designated schedule to drink different types of liquids depending the time of day. The liquids includes herbal tea, herbal solutions, clear soup, enzyme, fruit juice, and the star is techers’s proprietary “Tanya Oil”.

Should the fasting been done alone in our normal setting, I think it would be really hard to do as the body craving more and more for food. But in this retreat, we are encircled with the supportive environment, i.e: tranquil and beatiful gardens set with Buddhist theme helps us to relax and enjoy the present moment, socializing with other guests from different nations doing the same program made us feel strengthen, and the time that we had meeting with teacher Khun Kob made us inspired. In those meetings, she shares stories about her success journey developing the program in response for her health issue years ago, her gift of interpreting health issues in others, and her virtuous purpose in the world.

For the two of us, it had been a memorable journey; the restrictions of food and the oil consumption was very challenging, but after all, we together learned a very important lesson about taking care of our own body by adopting a better mindset. We understand that graduating from 8 days program from Tanya Samui was not the end of the challenge, but rather, a new guerila to maintain the better attitude towards life. We sincerely pray that the Teacher and her staffs to be always resourceful in spreading the love, knowledge and spirit broader to the world.
